card.name: Commas and linking words before next item
card.fires_on: Commas, and small linking words like "an", "his", "including" or "are", that come just before the next item in a list or phrase. The next word is often a P-word such as Physical, premature, or participant.

modes.label: Comma in a list
modes.description: A comma after a list item, right before the next listed field or category.
modes.example: - Why is Play Important? Social and Emotional Development<<,>> Physical Development, Creative Development - Smart

modes.label: Linking word after a clause
modes.description: A word like "including", "his" or "an" that joins a phrase to the noun that follows.
